text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: ...Haaah? Filming dance footage, you say?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep. Espo-chan and I are holding a 
fan meeting soon, right? It's for promo.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Since we're doing this, let's make 
something that'll go viral, yeah?♪ Like 
dancing together to a trend on UmaTok or 
something!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Haaaah~!? What the hell! If we do that, 
they're gonna walk all over us!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh, come on, let's do it~. It's you and 
me, isn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then how about a little give-and-take? 
Like intel on those super sweet lollipops 
that are rave hits overseas.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Wha! Too sweet...!? H-Hmph, no way!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Then how about a secret general store, hm? 
They've got tons of flashy gold 
accessories, and they're usually having 
sales, too.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Mgggh...! You're persistent! I ain't ever 
gonna do it!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm, I see. Got it. It's a shame, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"My fans, and Espo-chan's fans too... I 
thought everyone would be happy, but..."

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Espon, you appear in my videos from time 
to time, right? Your fans are always sooo 
happy to see you there, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"We got to see a different side of 
Espo-san!" ...they said. I was hoping 
everyone would be just as happy this time 
around too, but—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: —Aaaargh! Fine, I get it!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
If you insist that much, I'll go along 
with it! But listen here—

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"If we're doing this, we're making a video 
so awesome the fans will be terrified! 
Brace yourselves, punks!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, roger that~♪ I love that side of 
you, Espon.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Guess "this" really works best on you 
after all, Espon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...One day, my eyes widened as I saw a 
video that was supposedly buzzing among 
Espoir City's fans.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
"Kyu-kyun! Ratatchura! Many-many!!" ...I'm 
not done yet, you hear me, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah~, thanks to Espo-chan, it totally 
went viral~. Much appreciated, much 
appreciated♪

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! If this ends in a pathetic 
result, I'm gonna beat your ass, got it?!
choice_data_list:
Maybe we can use this for the Winning 
Live?
I'm just glad all the fans were happy.

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text: Like hell there is, dumbass!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
What I wanna do is flashy dancing and a 
killer performance fit for a strong 
Umamusume! Hmph!

text_block_list.name: Espoir City
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Even if that's true, this is the 
only time, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thanks a million. Let's really liven 
things up on the big day♪
